principles: Preserve the locked hierarchy and target OVR; never inflate unrelated traits to match it.
Use the existing season-phase-aware Full Audit gate without weakening evidence standards.
Evaluate each trait independently, explain why not higher/lower, and preserve evidenced weaknesses.
Same-OVR players require distinct supported builds; archetypes describe completed cards.
Use exact-trait 90/95/97/99 standards; never prescribe a quota or normalize every elite QB upward.
Explicit user approval is required for every transition beyond PROPOSED in this reconstruction workflow.
No engine formula, editor order, or historical full-card values are inferred.

evidence_domains.arm_strength: Evaluate usable velocity/distance separately from downfield placement.
evidence_domains.short_accuracy: Chart short placement by difficulty, throw type and sample.
evidence_domains.intermediate_accuracy: Chart intermediate windows, anticipation and placement.
evidence_domains.deep_accuracy: Chart deep placement with separation, pressure and sample uncertainty.
evidence_domains.pressure_performance: Separate execution under pressure from protection and decisions.
evidence_domains.pocket_movement: Evaluate footwork, spatial awareness and platform recovery without conflating contact escapes.
evidence_domains.sack_avoidance: Separate pressure avoidance, decisions, protection, release and actual sack-contact breaks.
evidence_domains.processing_decision_making: Evaluate reads, anticipation, risk and situational decisions; reputation is context only.
evidence_domains.play_action: Separate fake execution from scheme-generated production.
evidence_domains.throws_on_run: Evaluate passing while moving by direction, platform and depth; rushing is not a substitute.
evidence_domains.scrambling: Separate unplanned rushing decisions, space creation, speed and outcomes.
evidence_domains.designed_rushing: Separate designed carries and sneaks from scrambles/kneeldowns; control for blocking and opportunities.
evidence_domains.ball_security: Separate carrying fumbles, strip sacks and exchange failures from interceptions.
evidence_domains.durability: Use sourced injury history and exposure without diagnosing or inventing medical certainty.
evidence_domains.workload_availability: Account for snaps, practice, role, missed time, rest and current readiness.
evidence_domains.consistency: Track repeatability and trend over meaningful samples; do not duplicate total production.
evidence_domains.opponent_context_adjustments: Record opponent quality, coverage, protection, receivers, scheme, game state, weather and sample differences; no invented adjustment coefficients.
